text: Italy participated in the 1964 Winter Olympics held in Innsbruck, Austria. The nation sent 61 competitors, consisting of 53 men and 8 women. Italy earned a total of 4 medals, comprising 1 silver and 3 bronze. The medal-winning teams, highlighted in bold, qualified for Group A to compete for the 1st to 8th positions. Teams that lost their qualification matches were assigned to Group B to compete for the 9th to 16th positions. In the men's doubles event, athletes completed three jumps, with the best two results being recorded and presented.
